cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you put your coat on, I'd like to formally conclude our coffee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only stopped for ten minutes. My bus is due.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then I'll consider an early departure. Sit down while I decide.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The café's closing. They've asked us both to leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. We'll wait outside together. Their permission to leave doesn't replace mine.

mechanism: A maintains personal control of a social visitor departure even when the venue grants and requires both people to leave.
confusable: This is not merely wanting company: A treats leave-taking itself as a privilege only A can confer, directly joining both cards.
comparison: A social coffee competes with cafe closure, distinct from shop employment and a family taxi.
seedUse: The existing D50-b explicit conflict between venue and personal permission is already a specific combined scene.
